scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.lint:backend: node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check backend scripts && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check backend scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:backend: node scripts/python.mjs -m mypy backend/src backend/tests scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:backend && npm --workspace frontend run test
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/python.mjs -m alembic -c backend/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.verify: npm run validate:safety && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run validate:postgresql-ci && npm run validate:quality && npm run validate:continuity && npm run demo:verify
